boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a recipient's copy never carries it. Declared because the face prints it (FR-016).

document.notes: THIS DOCUMENT ROUTES NOWHERE, deliberately - like Form 5498 it verifies rather than places. Form 8889 is built from the taxpayer's own contributions (line 2) and the employer's (line 9, from Form W-2 box 12 code W), not from this form. Two traps make it unusable as a routing source. (1) Box 2 is 'Total contributions made IN 2025', which mixes contributions FOR 2024 made in early 2025 with contributions FOR 2025; box 3 separately reports contributions made in 2026 FOR 2025. Neither box is 'contributions for 2025'. (2) Box 2 includes EMPLOYER contributions, which belong on Form 8889 line 9 and REDUCE the line 13 deduction - so copying box 2 to line 2 overstates the deduction by the employer's share.
